name: B10-0559/2025 – Motion for a resolution
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the draft Commission Implementing Decision authorising the placing on the market of food, food ingredients and feed produced from genetically modified sugar beet KWS20-1 pursuant to Regulation (EC) No 1829/2003 of the European Parliament and of the Council
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking the European Commission to withdraw its plan to allow food, food ingredients and animal feed made from a genetically modified sugar beet, called KWS20-1, into the European Union. The beet is engineered to survive being sprayed with three weedkillers: glyphosate, dicamba and glufosinate. Parliament says the safety checks were too narrow, the weedkillers harm health and the environment, and European farmers would be undercut. This is Parliament's opinion; it does not itself block the plan.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only asks the Commission to withdraw the plan and not authorise the beet.
- **Who it affects:** European farmers, food and feed importers, and consumers if the beet enters the market.
- **What happens next:** The Commission decides whether to withdraw or keep its plan; Parliament also wants new rules on how such decisions are made.
